channel.title: NorthEast News
channel.description: Clear, fast reporting for New Hampshire and New England.

item.title: Rhode Island certifies Aaron Guckian as GOP governor nominee
item.description: State election officials certified the Sept. 9 primary after reviews of three close contests left their outcomes unchanged; turnout topped 20%.

item.title: Altera confidentially files for a U.S. initial public offering
item.description: The Silver Lake- and Intel-backed chipmaker says its parent submitted a draft Form S-1, while the potential offering’s size and price remain undetermined.

item.title: Mistrial declared in New Hampshire YDC sexual-assault case
item.description: A judge ended Jeffrey Buskey’s trial after testimony referred to allegations involving other staff; prosecutors say they will consider whether to retry the case.

item.title: Massachusetts proposes expanded postpartum mental-health support
item.description: Gov. Maura Healey is seeking $2.25 million to broaden newborn home visits and strengthen a clinician-consultation program, alongside planned screening-rule changes.

item.title: NHTSA sets deadline for Tesla Cybercab certification answers
item.description: The federal auto-safety agency is asking how Tesla concluded its driverless vehicle complied with existing standards, including whether temporary human controls factored into testing.

item.title: NH police departments tied to surge in ICE arrests, NHPR analysis finds
item.description: A data review says local departments accounted for nearly half of 198 people detained in New Hampshire from May through July as 287(g) partnerships expanded.

item.title: 54 New Hampshire National Guard members prepare for Texas border mission
item.description: Two New Hampshire Army National Guard units are expected to deploy next month for a year-long mission supporting U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

item.title: Osterville man pleads not guilty after officer struck outside Hyannis concert
item.description: Prosecutors say a speeding pickup hit a Barnstable officer directing traffic Sunday; the officer underwent surgery and his condition was not released.

item.title: Massachusetts shellfish harvesters receive $300,000 after Haverhill sewage leak
item.description: Relief checks went to about 130 clammers after a 12-day emergency closure along the North Shore.

item.title: Cranston underpass floods again as residents press for long-term fix
item.description: Water filled the Oaklawn Avenue underpass during heavy rain Sunday, trapping vehicles below the bike-path bridge.

item.title: URI opens $99 million Fine Arts Center renovation in Kingston
item.description: A ribbon-cutting marked the opening of a renovated arts facility and a new three-story academic building on Monday.

item.title: Mitch McConnell returns to Senate after three-month health-related absence
item.description: The Kentucky Republican said he would cast his first Senate vote since a June fall as he continues physical therapy.

item.title: EPA moves to repeal power-plant climate rule, setting up court fights
item.description: The agency says the rollback will cut industry costs, while environmental groups promise legal challenges and warn of broader pollution impacts.

item.title: AI data-center demand pushes PFAS producers toward expansion, survey says
item.description: A ChemSec review cited by The Guardian says nearly all of the 10 largest PFAS manufacturers plan higher output for semiconductor and cooling demand.

item.title: Lagarde warns Europe risks AI dependence without more local capacity
item.description: The ECB president said imported AI systems could leave every sector exposed if access changes, while local infrastructure could lift productivity.

item.title: BIS says AI-led market rally showing signs of vulnerability
item.description: The central-bank umbrella group says investors are more cautious about future AI profitability as tech leverage rises, though it sees no broad market stress.

item.title: Dollar gains as oil, rate-hike expectations reshape market mood
item.description: The U.S. dollar index was up 0.3% at 99.41 in Reuters’ Monday report as investors weighed Middle East oil risks and a possible Fed hike.

item.title: Tom Aspinall gives up UFC heavyweight belt while recovering from eye injury
item.description: The British fighter says ongoing complications and another accident made him relinquish the title, but he is not retiring.

item.title: Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran’s U.S. tour after pro-Palestinian remarks
item.description: The rapper says the remaining support dates were canceled after venue owners objected to his political comments at a New Jersey concert.

item.title: Two arrested in fire that destroyed historic Kimball Castle in Gilford
item.description: New Hampshire authorities arrested two young men in connection with an incendiary fire that destroyed the historic Lakes Region property last year.

item.title: Boston report details Flock data-sharing failure during police pilot
item.description: A city review says a Flock Safety error briefly allowed outside agencies to access vehicle information collected during Boston’s camera pilot.

item.title: Boston Medical Center nurses vote to authorize strike
item.description: Nearly 90% of the hospital’s union-represented nurses backed a strike authorization as contract negotiations continue, though no walkout has been scheduled.

item.title: One dead, one critically injured after I-95 rollover in Providence
item.description: A passenger died and the driver remained critically injured after a single-car rollover on northbound I-95, Rhode Island State Police said.

item.title: Rhode Island delegation asks FEMA to explain denied blizzard aid
item.description: The state’s congressional delegation is seeking records after FEMA rejected Rhode Island’s request for about $19 million tied to February’s blizzard response.

item.title: European officials condemn Russian drone strike near Poland border
item.description: France’s foreign minister said a Russian drone strike near Ukraine’s border with NATO member Poland was intended to intimidate and divide European countries.

item.title: EPA moves to repeal power-plant greenhouse gas limits
item.description: The Environmental Protection Agency says it is eliminating rules that limit greenhouse-gas emissions from coal- and natural-gas-fired power plants.

item.title: Cornelis raises $205 million for AI chip networking technology
item.description: The AI infrastructure company says its new funding will support networking technology designed to help AI chips communicate more efficiently.

item.title: Morgan & Morgan announces $1 billion AI investment plan
item.description: The personal-injury law firm says it plans to invest $1 billion in artificial intelligence and technology over the next decade, including expansion of its internal platform.

item.title: Kimberly-Clark prepares concessions to win approval for Kenvue deal
item.description: Kimberly-Clark is preparing possible asset sales to address European antitrust concerns over its proposed $40 billion acquisition of Kenvue, Reuters reports.

item.title: Dangote launches Africa’s largest IPO with oil refinery share sale
item.description: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote launched an IPO for his oil refinery, targeting up to $2.1 billion to fund expansion in what Reuters calls Africa’s largest share sale.

item.title: Emmy Awards arrive with ‘The Pitt,’ ‘Hacks’ and ‘Widow’s Bay’ in spotlight
item.description: The 78th Emmy Awards take place Monday night, with NBC’s drama winner ‘The Pitt’ and comedy contenders ‘Hacks’ and ‘Widow’s Bay’ among the evening’s main storylines.

item.title: Jefferson-Wooden and Bednarek sweep sprint titles in Budapest
item.description: Melissa Jefferson-Wooden and Kenny Bednarek each won the 100- and 200-meter races at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship.

item.title: New Hampshire crypto ATM protections set to take effect in December
item.description: New Hampshire’s new cryptocurrency ATM rules will add transaction limits, a first-use delay and a fraud-refund process beginning Dec. 16.

item.title: Massachusetts has more than 1,200 automated license-plate readers, Axios finds
item.description: A new tally finds automated license-plate readers operating across Massachusetts, renewing questions about how police technology is deployed and overseen.

item.title: Boston judge blocks visa-duration rule affecting foreign students and journalists
item.description: A federal judge in Boston temporarily blocked a Homeland Security rule that would have limited the duration of several student, exchange and journalist visas.

item.title: Rhode Island delegation demands records after FEMA denies blizzard aid
item.description: Rhode Island’s congressional delegation is asking for FEMA records as it challenges the agency’s decision not to issue a major-disaster declaration after February’s blizzard.

item.title: Rhode Island lifts Georgiaville Pond algae advisory after bloom clears
item.description: State health and environmental officials lifted a recreational warning for Georgiaville Pond in Smithfield while keeping a high-risk contact advisory in place for Lower Melville Pond.

item.title: At least 21 killed in South Africa crash involving two taxis and SUV
item.description: At least 21 people died in a head-on collision in South Africa’s Western Cape, authorities said, with the death toll potentially changing as the investigation continues.

item.title: Houthis claim control of two strategic Red Sea islands as Yemen fighting widens
item.description: Houthi rebels say they seized Greater and Lesser Hanish in the southern Red Sea, a claim that could signal a new front near the Bab el-Mandeb shipping route.

item.title: Temporal raises $550 million as valuation more than doubles to $12.55 billion
item.description: Workflow-software company Temporal has raised $550 million in a late-stage funding round led by Lightspeed, lifting its reported valuation to $12.55 billion.

item.title: Waymo to bring public robotaxi rides to Las Vegas
item.description: Alphabet’s self-driving unit Waymo says it will open its Las Vegas ride-hailing service to the general public, adding Nevada to its growing robotaxi network.

item.title: Kimberly-Clark prepares concessions to win EU approval for Kenvue deal
item.description: Kimberly-Clark is preparing remedies for European regulators reviewing its planned $40 billion acquisition of Kenvue, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: AirBaltic files for Chapter 11 as higher fuel costs strain airline
item.description: Latvian carrier airBaltic has entered Chapter 11 restructuring in New York and secured a proposed $405 million financing package to keep flying during the process.

item.title: Yankees move closer to playoff berth with 2-0 win over Mets
item.description: The Yankees beat the Mets 2-0 in the final Subway Series game Sunday, moving within one win of securing a postseason spot.

item.title: The Pitt, Hacks headline Emmy race ahead of Monday night ceremony
item.description: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards will air Monday night with The Pitt defending its drama presence and Hacks’ Jean Smart chasing another comedy-acting win.

item.title: Dozens of rescuers help injured hiker off Mount Lafayette
item.description: A 62-year-old hiker was rescued from Mount Lafayette Saturday after an injury prompted a coordinated response, WMUR reported.

item.title: N.H. DOT to begin road work on Everett Turnpike in Merrimack
item.description: Road work planned for the Everett Turnpike in Merrimack could affect commuters and commercial traffic using the southern New Hampshire corridor.

item.title: Springfield schools reopen as cyberattack investigation continues
item.description: Springfield Public Schools reopened Monday after a cyberattack shut the district down during the first weeks of the school year.

item.title: Spotted lanternfly spreads across more than 150 Massachusetts communities
item.description: State officials say Massachusetts is shifting from trying to eradicate spotted lanternflies to managing their impact on crops, trees and vineyards.

item.title: Glocester police investigate rash of vehicle break-ins
item.description: Police are asking residents in three Glocester areas to review home-security footage after vehicles were broken into early Monday.
